outline: １.TTL，CMOS邏輯閘之特性實習２.組合邏輯電路設計實習含：算術電路，比較器，解碼器，編碼器，多工器，解多工器等３.序向邏輯電路設計與應用：正反器，計數器，記錄器，及移位暫存器等綜合應用４.FPGA設計規劃。

Lab reports: 20 %
Final exam: 20 % (*)

Students whose final exam scores below 40 points are determined not to have enough knowledge to complete the experiments independently. Therefore, the instructor reserve the rights not count the points of some worked circuits and reports for these students.
